name: ME Cabo by Melia
insider_take: This ultra-modern beachfront stunner sits at the tip of the Baja Peninsula where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez—one of only a handful of places on Earth where two seas converge.
whats_special: ME Cabo features a dramatic rooftop infinity pool that appears to spill directly into the Sea of Cortez, plus exclusive access to Playa El Médano—Cabo's only swimmable beach. The hotel's signature RADIO rooftop bar offers 360-degree views of Land's End and the famous Arch of Cabo San Lucas.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at RADIO rooftop—you'll witness the rare phenomenon where the sun sets over the Pacific while the moon rises over the Sea of Cortez simultaneously.
dont_miss: Take the hotel's complimentary water taxi to Lover's Beach, accessible only by boat and nestled between towering rock formations. It's one of the few beaches in the world where you can swim in two different bodies of water just steps apart.
pros: Unbeatable Medano Beach Location with direct beach access and stunning Sea of Cortez views
Vibrant lifestyle atmosphere with rooftop pool, DJ entertainment, and curated social spaces
Chic, design-forward rooms and suites with modern amenities and ocean-facing balconies
Exceptional on-site dining and craft cocktail scene ideal for sophisticated travelers
Prime walkable position near Cabo's top restaurants, nightlife, and marina
cons: Adults-only property — not suitable for families with children
High-energy social scene may not appeal to guests seeking a quiet, relaxing retreat
